rawContent: 2020 is a moment of reckoning/wakeup call in all the ways. #ClimateChange is behind extreme weather, from #heatwaves to #derecho to #CAwildfires to #COwildfires to #TropicalStormLaura to #TropicalStormMarco to #firenadoes to...the next horrors we haven't yet seen. #actonclimate

This is my hope. @KamalaHarris, as a Californian, we're counting on you to win- and help the East Coast and the rest of the country grasp what the West is facing right now. We need 100% clean energy nationwide. Or else 2020 is a harbinger of our worse #climatecrisis yet to come.
